review_prompt: Confirm the Trust pathway title, authors, version, issue date and review date.
Confirm whether the October 2027 review date and local governance permit project use.
Confirm that adjusted calcium below 2.2 mmol/L defines Hypocalcaemia and that albumin adjustment is required.
Confirm the moderate/severe and mild bands and fail-closed handling of the 2.1 to 2.2 mmol/L source gap.
Resolve the exact 1.9 mmol/L mismatch between assessment severity and management wording.
Confirm the listed symptom and ECG-change groups and the explicit rapid-fall assessment.
Confirm the diagnostic investigation sequence and use of local laboratory reference states.
Approve a reusable ECG visual or confirm that the labelled placeholder must remain.
Supply or approve the applicable massive-blood-loss pathway before transfusion-related treatment is generated.
Confirm the expert-advice safeguard and the stop behavior when advice has not been obtained.
Confirm the acute-pancreatitis cause prompt and its non-inferential wording.
Confirm renal-failure, dialysis and end-stage renal-failure safeguards across oral and intravenous branches.
Confirm thyroidectomy and parathyroidectomy branches, postoperative monitoring and renal-physician discussion.
Supply the referenced local magnesium pathway or approve the current no-dose stop behavior.
Confirm the postoperative and other-cause branches and alfacalcidol safeguards.
Confirm medicine-related causes and that the workflow does not infer causality.
Confirm oral calcium selection, exact doses, follow-up thresholds and postoperative escalation.
Confirm initial and repeat intravenous calcium gluconate instructions and monitoring.
Define or approve the explicit infusion-need decision and renal exclusions.
Confirm the limited source-defined discharge wording and one-week calcium recheck.
Confirm stops for mild symptomatic, severe asymptomatic, uncertain and incomplete cases.
Resolve the missing calcium-gluconate monograph, supporting-pathway mismatch and reuse status.
Confirm clinical priority, terminology, mobile layout, accessibility and absence of visible internal references.
Record approved, changes requested or rejected; name reviewers and date the decision.
